questions.question:
Introducing a man, Shamita said, “He is the only son of my mother’s mother.”

How is Shamita related to the man?

A. Mother

B. Aunt

C. Sister

D. Niece
questions.solution:
Introducing a man, Shamita said, “He is the only son of my mother’s mother.”

Mother’s mother is maternal grandmother and son of maternal grandmother is maternal uncle. So, the man is maternal uncle of Shamita or Shamita is the niece of the man.
